offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells injectable, inhalation and intranasal generic and proprietary pharmaceutical products, plus insulin and biosimilar candidates. Sells mainly to hospitals, clinics, wholesalers and distributors. Also makes active pharmaceutical ingredients in-house.

primary_products.value: enoxaparin injection; naloxone; epinephrine and other injectable generics; glucagon; inhalation products; active pharmaceutical ingredients

customer_segment.value: B2B: drug wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, group purchasing organizations, pharmacies, clinics; B2G: government health programs and agencies purchasing naloxone and emergency drugs

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospital pharmaceuticals; emergency medicine; diabetes care; anticoagulation

revenue_model.value: product sales: generic and proprietary injectable, nasal and inhalation drugs and APIs

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures finished drugs and APIs from purchased raw materials, sold to wholesalers and hospitals; brand owner: markets proprietary products such as asthma inhalers and hyaluronidase

geography_served.value: global: Mainly United States, with manufacturing in the US and China and sales in other markets

specialization.value: related lines: generic injectables, inhalation products, proprietary drugs, insulin and APIs

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: major drug wholesalers and distributors; direct sales: hospitals, group purchasing organizations and retail pharmacies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and manufacturing compliance under FDA, DEA controlled-substance rules and cGMP

notes: Product list from general knowledge; current portfolio may have changed.
